intended_object: An auxiliary fresh variable for a machine-generated nominal/alpha-renaming proof certificate (upstream label `nb095_alpha_dummy_787`). It is the first variable not among the free variables of a compiled class term. I inferred this from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body applies `freshVar` to the union of the free-variable set of `synCphi (Class.cv (nb095AlphaDummy662 D R S_cls E))` with itself. The union is redundant, which is typical of generated code. The result is a variable to use as a dummy in an alpha-renaming step. This is an internal device of the library's proof-certificate machinery, part of a numbered series of generated dummies. It has no standard mathematical counterpart, so the faithful / too_narrow / incorrect assessment does not apply.
